body: I just want to clarify: in place of doing unpacking, the constructor should accept a dictionary itself? We would also need to fix it in the parent class NeighborBase since it is accepting **kwargs as well. Is that correct?

Yeah, that's correct. Any classifier that accepts **kwargs will break the cloning API.

I don't think the utility routine in `NeighborsBase` needs to be changed, because it's not an outward-facing `__init__` method.

I'd do it this way: in `KNeighborsClassifier` and `KNeighborsRegressor`, add a `metric_params` dictionary argument (default = None) and keep the **kwargs for now; if the user passes anything to kwargs, raise a suitable DeprecationWarning and populate `metric_params` with those values.
Thanks! I will work on this.

issue.title: [MRG+1] FIX #3566: redefine isfinite alias in sklearn
issue.body:
`npy_isfinite` from `npy_math.h` depends on the compiler used to build numpy. If we build scikit-learn with a different compiler (e.g. MSVC vs MinGW) this can cause link errors.

Therefore we redefine the isfinite macro in a scikit-learn specific header file.
